(()=>{const summary=document.querySelector('.price-book-card summary').getBoundingClientRect(),assistant=document.querySelector('.live-assistant').getBoundingClientRect();if(summary.height<44||summary.bottom>assistant.top)throw Error('Removal summary still overlaps the assistant');return {summary:summary.toJSON(),assistant:assistant.toJSON()};})()

(()=>{const button=[...document.querySelectorAll('.price-book-card button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Confirm remove priced line');const rect=button.getBoundingClientRect(),assistant=document.querySelector('.live-assistant').getBoundingClientRect();if(rect.height<44||rect.bottom>assistant.top||rect.top<0)throw Error('Removal confirmation still overlaps assistant');return {button:rect.toJSON(),assistant:assistant.toJSON()};})()
